newsitem.title: USA: Reliv U.S. October sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Reliv U.S. October sales rise.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said on Tuesday that net sales from U.S. operations in October totaled more than $3.7 million, a 99 percent increase over the prior year period.
Reliv said these sales, equivalent to $5.6 million at suggested retail prices, made October its strongest month in over three years.

The company said sales benefited from Arthaffect, its first product in the functional food category, which includes products designed for patients suffering from specific diseases or conditions. Arthaffect contains an ingredient that has been shown to reduce the effects of arthritis and other degenerative joint diseases. Arthaffect contributed over $500,000 in net sales, or $900,000 at suggested retail prices, during its first month on the market.
"We're very excited about the potential of Arthaffect, as well as the functional food category in general," chairman Robert Montgomery said in a statement.
Reliv also makes nutritional supplements and other dietary products.
